newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee opens steady vs dlr, awaits RBI moves.
newsitem.headline: India rupee opens steady vs dlr, awaits RBI moves.

text.p: * The Indian rupee opened Monday at 35.795/805 per dollar against the weekend close of 35.805/815, dealers said.
* Rupee seen gaining against the dollar on strong supply and poor demand, they said.
* Dealers uncertain of outlook, await central bank moves to determine trading range.
* "It is all up to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Rupee will move up unless they (RBI) buy dollars."
* Dealers said they expected rupee to move up to 35.75 unless central bank intervened.
* In latest deals, dollar quoted 35.80/81 rupees.
